ayahs.ar: اِقۡتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانۡشَقَّ الۡقَمَرُ
ayahs.tl: Iqtarabatis Saa'atu wsan shaqqal qamar
ayahs.en: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ يَّرَوۡا اٰيَةً يُّعۡرِضُوۡا وَيَقُوۡلُوۡا سِحۡرٌ مُّسۡتَمِرٌّ
ayahs.tl: Wa iny yaraw aayatany yu'ridoo wa yaqooloo sihrum mustamirr
ayahs.en: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

ayahs.ar: وَكَذَّبُوۡا وَاتَّبَعُوۡ٘ا اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡ وَكُلُّ اَمۡرٍ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.tl: Wa kazzaboo wattaba'ooo ahwaaa'ahum; wa kullu amrim mustaqirr
ayahs.en: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَنۭۡ بَآءِ مَا فِيۡهِ مُزۡدَجَرٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum minal ambaaa'i maa feehi muzdajar
ayahs.en: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -

ayahs.ar: حِكۡمَةٌۭ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغۡنِ النُّذُرُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Hikmatum baalighatun famaa tughnin nuzur
ayahs.en: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

ayahs.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡۘ يَوۡمَ يَدۡعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰي شَيۡءٍ نُّكُرٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Fatawalla 'anhum; yawma yad'ud daa'i ilaa shai 'in nukur
ayahs.en: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

ayahs.ar: خُشَّعًا اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٌ مُّنۡتَشِرٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: khushsha'an absaaruhum yakrujoona minal ajdaasi ka annahum jaraadum muntashir
ayahs.en: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

ayahs.ar: مُّهۡطِعِيۡنَ اِلَي الدَّاعِؕ يَقُوۡلُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَ هٰذَا يَوۡمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahs.tl: Muhti'eena ilad daa'i yaqoolul kafiroona haazaa yawmun 'asir
ayahs.en: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوۡحٍ فَكَذَّبُوۡا عَبۡدَنَا وَقَالُوۡا مَجۡنُوۡنٌ وَّازۡدُجِرَ
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qablahum qawmu Noohin fakazzaboo 'abdanaa wa qaaloo majnoo nunw wazdujir
ayahs.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

ayahs.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗ٘ اَنِّيۡ مَغۡلُوۡبٌ فَانۡتَصِرۡ‏
ayahs.tl: Fada'aa Rabbahooo annee maghloobun fantasir
ayahs.en: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

ayahs.ar: فَفَتَحۡنَا٘ اَبۡوَابَ السَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنۡهَمِرٍؗۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fafatahnaaa abwaabas sa maaa'i bimaa'im munhamir
ayahs.en: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

ayahs.ar: وَّفَجَّرۡنَا الۡاَرۡضَ عُيُوۡنًا فَالۡتَقَي الۡمَآءُ عَلٰ٘ي اَمۡرٍ قَدۡ قُدِرَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa fajjamal arda 'uyoonan faltaqal maaa'u 'alaaa amrin qad qudir
ayahs.en: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

ayahs.ar: وَحَمَلۡنٰهُ عَلٰي ذَاتِ اَلۡوَاحٍ وَّدُسُرٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa hamalnaahu 'alaa zaati alwaahinw wa dusur
ayahs.en: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

ayahs.ar: تَجۡرِيۡ بِاَعۡيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَنۡ كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.tl: Tajree bi a'yuninaa jazaaa 'al liman kaana kufir
ayahs.en: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ تَّرَكۡنٰهَا٘ اٰيَةً فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqat taraknaahaad aayatan fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.en: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
ayahs.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mimmuddakir
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ عَادٌ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat 'Aadun fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
ayahs.en: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ رِيۡحًا صَرۡصَرًا فِيۡ يَوۡمِ نَحۡسٍ مُّسۡتَمِرٍّۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim reehan sarsaran fee Yawmi nahsim mustamirr
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

ayahs.ar: تَنۡزِعُ النَّاسَۙ كَاَنَّهُمۡ اَعۡجَازُ نَخۡلٍ مُّنۡقَعِرٍ
ayahs.tl: Tanzi;un naasa ka anna huma'jaazu nakhlim munqa'ir
ayahs.en: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tl: 'Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
ayahs.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassamal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ ثَمُوۡدُ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat Samoodu binnuzur
ayahs.en: Thamud denied the warning

ayahs.ar: فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهٗ٘ۙ اِنَّا٘ اِذًا لَّفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ
ayahs.tl: Faqaalooo a-basharam minnaa waahidan nattabi'uhooo innaa izal lafee dalaalinw wa su'ur
ayahs.en: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

ayahs.ar: ءَاُلۡقِيَ الذِّكۡرُ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِنَا بَلۡ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ
ayahs.tl: 'A-ulqiyaz zikru 'alaihi mim baininaa bal huwa kazzaabun ashir
ayahs.en: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

ayahs.ar: سَيَعۡلَمُوۡنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الۡكَذَّابُ الۡاَشِرُ
ayahs.tl: Sa-ya'lamoona ghadam manil kazzaabul ashir
ayahs.en: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا مُرۡسِلُوا النَّاقَةِ فِتۡنَةً لَّهُمۡ فَارۡتَقِبۡهُمۡ وَاصۡطَبِرۡؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa mursilun naaqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum wastabir
ayahs.en: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

ayahs.ar: وَنَبِّئۡهُمۡ اَنَّ الۡمَآءَ قِسۡمَةٌۭ بَيۡنَهُمۡۚ كُلُّ شِرۡبٍ مُّحۡتَضَرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa nabbi'hum annal maaa'a qismatum bainahum kullu shirbim muhtadar
ayahs.en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

ayahs.ar: فَنَادَوۡا صَاحِبَهُمۡ فَتَعَاطٰي فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.tl: Fanaadaw saahibahum fata'aataa fa'aqar
ayahs.en: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Fakaifa kaana 'azaabee wa nuzur
ayahs.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَكَانُوۡا كَهَشِيۡمِ الۡمُحۡتَظِرِ
ayahs.tl: Innaaa arsalnaa 'alaihim saihatanw waahidatan fakaano kahasheemil muhtazir
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassarnal quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبَتۡ قَوۡمُ لُوۡطٍۭ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Kazzabat qawmu lootim binnuzur
ayahs.en: The people of Lot denied the warning.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَاصِبًا اِلَّا٘ اٰلَ لُوۡطٍؕ نَجَّيۡنٰهُمۡ بِسَحَرٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa arsalnaa 'alaihim haasiban illaaa aala Loot najjainaahum bisahar
ayahs.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn

ayahs.ar: نِّعۡمَةً مِّنۡ عِنۡدِنَاؕ كَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِيۡ مَنۡ شَكَرَ
ayahs.tl: Ni'matam min 'indinaa; kazaalika najzee man shakar
ayahs.en: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَنۡذَرَهُمۡ بَطۡشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوۡا بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad anzarahum batshatanaa fatamaaraw binnuzur
ayahs.en: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ رَاوَدُوۡهُ عَنۡ ضَيۡفِهٖ فَطَمَسۡنَا٘ اَعۡيُنَهُمۡ فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad raawadoohu 'andaifee fatamasnaaa a'yunahum fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur
ayahs.en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُمۡ بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسۡتَقِرٌّۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad sabbahahum bukratan 'azaabum mustaqirr
ayahs.en: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

ayahs.ar: فَذُوۡقُوۡا عَذَابِيۡ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.tl: Fazooqoo 'azaabee wa nuzur
ayahs.en: So taste My punishment and warning.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ يَسَّرۡنَا الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لِلذِّكۡرِ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad yassarnal Quraana liz zikri fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.en: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَ اٰلَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ النُّذُرُۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'a Aala Fir'awnan nuzur
ayahs.en: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

ayahs.ar: كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذۡنٰهُمۡ اَخۡذَ عَزِيۡزٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍ
ayahs.tl: Kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa kullihaa fa akhaznaahum akhza 'azeezim muqtadir
ayahs.en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

ayahs.ar: اَكُفَّارُكُمۡ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اُولٰٓئِكُمۡ اَمۡ لَكُمۡ بَرَآءَةٌ فِي الزُّبُرِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Akuffaarukum khairum min ulaaa'ikum am lakum baraaa'atun fiz Zubur
ayahs.en: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ نَحۡنُ جَمِيۡعٌ مُّنۡتَصِرٌ
ayahs.tl: Am yaqooloona nahnu jamee'um muntasir
ayahs.en: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

ayahs.ar: سَيُهۡزَمُ الۡجَمۡعُ وَيُوَلُّوۡنَ الدُّبُرَ
ayahs.tl: Sa yuhzamul jam'u wa yuwalloonad dubur
ayahs.en: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

ayahs.ar: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوۡعِدُهُمۡ وَالسَّاعَةُ اَدۡهٰي وَاَمَرُّ
ayahs.tl: Balis Saa'atu maw'iduhum was Saa'atu adhaa wa amarr
ayahs.en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍۘ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal mujrimeena fee dalaalinw wa su'ur
ayahs.en: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ يُسۡحَبُوۡنَ فِي النَّارِ عَلٰي وُجُوۡهِهِمۡؕ ذُوۡقُوۡا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma yushaboona fin Naari'alaa wujoohimim zooqoo massa saqar
ayahs.en: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَيۡءٍ خَلَقۡنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
ayahs.tl: Innaa kulla shai'in khalaqnaahu biqadar
ayahs.en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَمۡرُنَا٘ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمۡحٍۭ بِالۡبَصَرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa amrunaaa illaa waahidatun kalamhim bilbasar
ayahs.en: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا٘ اَشۡيَاعَكُمۡ فَهَلۡ مِنۡ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad ahlaknaaa ashyaa'akum fahal mim muddakir
ayahs.en: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ شَيۡءٍ فَعَلُوۡهُ فِي الزُّبُرِ
ayahs.tl: Wa kullu shai'in fa'aloohu fiz Zubur
ayahs.en: And everything they did is in written records.

ayahs.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيۡرٍ وَّكَبِيۡرٍ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa kullu sagheerinw wa kabeerim mustatar
ayahs.en: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ فِيۡ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَهَرٍۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal muttaqeena fee jannaatinw wa nahar
ayahs.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

ayahs.ar: فِيۡ مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِنۡدَ مَلِيۡكٍ مُّقۡتَدِرٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fee maq'adi sidqin 'inda Maleekim Muqtadir
ayahs.en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
